problem: The official archived HUMPOP table contains multiple rows for some identical studyName + Date + Island + Colony keys, but the archive schema contains no time, observer, subsite, or replicate identifier that could distinguish those records.

audit.dominant_pattern: Many discordant duplicates occur for PAL9293, HUM colony 2.1.

frozen_resolution.rule: Exclude every observation belonging to a duplicated studyName + Date + Island + Colony key from all HUMPOP arrival-curve analyses, regardless of whether the duplicated adult counts agree.
frozen_resolution.rationale: The archive does not document within-key replicate semantics, so any numerical combination rule would be arbitrary. Excluding the ambiguous date-colony key is fail-closed and independent of the performance-arrival association.

claim_boundary: The repair occurs after HUMPOP arrival values were opened for duplicate auditing but before any performance-arrival coefficient was computed.
No result from ambiguous duplicated date-colony keys may be used.
If the fail-closed repair leaves insufficient information under the frozen minimum-information rule, the analysis stops.
